content.stem: 不寻常的电汇交易可能包括:(选择两项.)

options.A: 同一客户在不同银行开设的账户之间以不同货币进行的电汇.
options.B: 一笔汇入的第三方电汇,随后以客户名义购买房产.
options.C: 一笔汇入的电汇,随后将贷款支付给与客户有业务往来的第三方.
options.D: 多次电汇至与客户相关的交易对手方,相关方信息依据客户尽职调查文件.

content.stem_en: Unusual wire transfer transactions can include: (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Wire transfers in different currencies between accounts held at different banks for the same client.
options_en.B: An incoming third-party wire transfer followed by the purchase of real estate in the client's name.
options_en.C: An incoming wire transfer followed by the loan payment to a third party that is a business associate of the client.
options_en.D: Multiple wire transfers sent to counterparties associated with the client as per KYC documentation.
